description: This file defines a ChatClient class for interacting with a chat completion API, including methods for standard and streaming completions, handling authorization, and constructing HTTP requests.

classes.name: ChatClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with a chat completion API, supporting both standard and streaming responses.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ChatClient with base URL and optional API key.

methods.name: _get_headers
methods.description: Constructs headers for API requests, including authorization if API key is set.

methods.name: completions
methods.description: Creates a chat completion request, returning either the response data or a prepared request object.

methods.name: completions_stream
methods.description: Creates a streaming chat completion, yielding response chunks as they arrive.
